scope: Ten unresolved Ministry of Education school records: facility:school:460, 461, 462, 463, 464, 466, 467, 468, 470, 471

method.official: Live Ministry of Education school pages were fetched over HTTPS and checked for HTTP 200, title, atoll, and contact address.
method.google_maps: Google Maps public search/place discovery was used for exact names and official-address variants. A place card is discovery evidence only; it was not treated as an OSM identity.
method.nominatim: Nominatim island searches were used for Makunudhoo, Nellaidhoo, and Neykurendhoo; later requests were rate-limited with HTTP 429, so no absence claim is based on those failed requests.
method.osm_api: Live OSM API map bboxes were scanned around each official OneMap island geometry for amenity=school, building=school, education=*, office=educational_institution, named school/education objects, and alternate name/operator/government tags. Generic building=yes polygons were not accepted as school geometry.
method.overpass: A narrow combined query timed out with HTTP 504 on overpass-api.de and overpass.kumi.systems. Per-island retries returned some zero-result responses but also 504/429 failures. No Overpass-only candidate was accepted.
method.decision_rule: Official island agreement is required. A candidate without facility-level identity, compatible category, and island agreement remains provisional or unresolved; wrong-island candidates are rejected.

official_source.evidence_quote: Makunudhoo School, Ziyaariah Magu, HDh. Makunudhoo, 02160

google_maps_discovery.observed: No usable place card or address was exposed in the limited Google Maps result view.

osm_scan.note: Only generic building polygons and unrelated ferry/worship objects were found; no school, educational-institution, operator, or government-tagged facility object.

records.safe_action: Do not attach a generic building or the island polygon; retain unresolved/island-context-only.

official_source.evidence_quote: Nellaidhoo School, Bon'Bithalhaa Magu, HDh. Nellaidhoo, 02070

google_maps_discovery.observed: Exact place discovery returned Nellaidhoo School, General education school, PW8W+F85 Kilegemagu Rd, plus a second Nellaidhoo School result on Nellaidhoo.

nominatim.result: OSM way 19879749, Nellaidhoo islet; same island context.

osm_scan.note: Google confirms a likely school place on the official island, but the live OSM bbox has no school/education/operator/government object; generic buildings cannot be safely selected.

records.safe_action: Keep the Google place as discovery evidence only; do not map it to an OSM object.

official_source.evidence_quote: Neykurendhoo School, Edhuru Hingun, HDh. Neykurendhoo, 02130

google_maps_discovery.observed: Exact place discovery returned Neykurendhoo School, School center, GXWG+MJH, phone 652-0528.

nominatim.result: OSM way 19879344, Neykurendhoo island; same island context.

osm_scan.note: This is the only alternate-category OSM candidate found in the ten live island scans. It is on the correct island and semantically educational, but lacks facility identity and operator/address evidence.

records.safe_action: Retain as a provisional candidate only; do not add as a reviewed mapping or deterministic geometry without official coordinates, a matching address, or additional facility-level evidence.

official_source.evidence_quote: Nolhivaranfaru School, Haveeree Hingun, HDh. Nolhivaranfaru, 02060

google_maps_discovery.observed: No usable school place card was exposed in the limited result view.

osm_scan.note: The island has named police and health objects, but no school or alternate educational facility object. Generic buildings are not safe substitutes.

records.safe_action: Do not map the school to a generic building or nearby health/police object.

osm_scan.note: The official island context is supported, but the live OSM scan has no named or educational school object.

records.safe_action: Keep the Google alternate-name discovery as unresolved evidence; do not attach the lone generic building.

official_source.evidence_quote: Sh. Atoll School, Ameenee Magu, Sh. Kanditheemu, 03010

osm_scan.note: Only a cafe, mosque, harbor, and one generic building were found; none supplies school identity.

records.safe_action: Do not create geometry from the Google plus code or island polygon; retain source-not-in-current-OSM-coverage.

google_maps_discovery.observed: No usable school place card was exposed in the limited result view.

osm_scan.note: Only generic buildings and the island polygon were found; no school or educational-institution tags.

records.safe_action: Do not attach one of the generic building polygons without facility identity evidence.

osm_scan.note: No live OSM facility object was found despite official/Google island agreement.

records.safe_action: Treat Bileyfahee as a Google/official name variant only; do not synthesize an OSM mapping from the plus code.

official_source.evidence_quote: Sh. Feydhoo School, Marukazee Hingun, Sh. Feydhoo, 03040

google_maps_discovery.observed: Exact place discovery returned Sh. Feydhoo School, School center, Unnamed Road, Feydhoo, 925X+34, phone 654-0579, rating 3.8.

osm_scan.note: Google confirms a school place on the correct island, but the live OSM bbox contains no school/education facility object.

records.safe_action: Do not map from the Google plus code or island polygon; retain unresolved/source-not-in-current-OSM-coverage.

summary.bottom_line: No school was safely promoted to a reviewed OSM mapping. Neykurendhoo has one same-island office=educational_institution building (way 1035327405), but missing name/operator/address identity keeps it provisional. Six schools have Google place discovery on the official island, while nine have no facility-level OSM object in the live island scan.
